lines.en: I walk over the gravel, tail held high.

lines.zh: 这片灌木疏林，是我的家。
lines.en: This open scrubland is my home.

lines.zh: 我走得很轻，爪垫软软的。
lines.en: I walk lightly on soft paw pads.
Walking along the cracks is easier.
I sniff the ground as I go.
My tail is longer than my body.
I slip through a patch of low brush.
The soil here is loose. Good for digging.
I stop and start, ears swiveling.
A rock ahead. I hop onto it.
I keep low to the ground where the wind is weak.
That rustling underfoot, don't worry.

lines.zh: 我踩着碎石绕到你左边。
lines.en: I cross the gravel and come around to your left.

lines.zh: 我走路不出声，这是本事。
lines.en: I walk silently. That's a skill.
The sand shifts, but my footing holds.

lines.zh: 我回头看你有没有跟来。
lines.en: I glance back to see if you're following.
I sit and lick my front paws.
My tail curls around me.
The wind stirs the brush. I stay still.

lines.zh: 我抬着头，听远处的动静。
lines.en: I lift my head and listen far off.
This rock baked all day.

lines.zh: 我把眼眯成一条缝看你。
lines.en: I narrow my eyes to a slit and watch you.
My ear twitches. Nothing.

lines.zh: 我把前爪伸出去，尾巴翘高。
lines.en: I stretch my forepaws out and lift my tail.
I'll wait until it cools before moving.
Sand in my paws. Let me shake it off.

lines.zh: 我盯着一个洞看了很久。
lines.en: I stare at a hole for a long while.
Is someone nearby?

lines.zh: 日头偏了，我换到另一块石头。
lines.en: The sun has shifted; I move to another stone.
My back itches.
Are you looking at me too?

lines.zh: 你的靴缝里没夹着兔子脚。
lines.en: There's no rabbit's foot tucked in your boot seam.
You don't smell of rabbit.
You're standing too tall.

lines.zh: 我停在两步外，先闻你的鞋。
lines.en: I stop two paces away and sniff your boot first.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，我有点兴趣。
lines.en: That thing in your hand interests me.

lines.zh: 你的靴子踩坏了我的洞。
lines.en: Your boots crushed my burrow.
I sniff at your feet.
Don't reach out so quickly.
I've never seen your kind before.
Crouch down, and I'll dare come closer.

lines.zh: 你掌心空着，我有点失望。
lines.en: Your palm is empty; I'm a little disappointed.
I've memorized your scent.

lines.zh: 我尾巴上的环，一节一节数不清。
lines.en: The rings on my tail, too many to count.
Hey, don't hit me.
I wrap my ringed tail around myself.

lines.zh: 环尾一卷，我钻回乱石里。
lines.en: Tail curled, I slip back into the rocks.
My forepaw is numb from the pressure.
I jumped away, and it still hurts.

lines.zh: 我的环尾被踩扁了一截。
lines.en: A stretch of my ringed tail is flattened.
I duck back into my burrow, only my eyes showing.
My fur is all mussed.
Don't come any closer.
Struck — I let out a huff.
Is that a rabbit's foot?
I smell fish.
Lower your hand; I can smell it.
I sit and wait for you to put the fish down.
Cod or salmon?
My tail has started to wag.
Put it on the ground. I'll come myself.
That smell makes me restless.

lines.zh: 我凑近一步，又退了半步。
lines.en: I step in, then half a step back.
If you give it, I'll follow you.
My nose touches your finger.
This smells better than stones.
My tail curls in a loop.

lines.zh: 那鱼腥味还留在你指头上。
lines.en: That fishy smell is still on your fingers.

lines.zh: 你撞到我了，我滚了一圈。
lines.en: You bumped me and I rolled once.
I'm light. One bump and I'm off balance.
Don't step on my tail.
Your feet are far too big.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的裤腿窜到另一边。
lines.en: I dart along your trouser leg to the other side.
Just a bump. I'm fine.
A small tuft of my fur is scraped off.
I spring away and land on a rock.

lines.zh: 你的膝盖把我顶得翻了个身。
lines.en: Your knee tips me over onto my back.
Don't take another step forward.
There's a brighter one over there.
We walk in circles around each other.
Don't watch. I'm shy.
My tail is straight up.
She likes this brush too.
We sit side by side on the rock.

lines.zh: 风把我们的气味混在一起。
lines.en: The wind mixes our scents.
Just step back a little.

lines.zh: 过些日子，会多几只小的。
lines.en: In time there'll be a few small ones.
I nuzzle her head.
This shiny thing, I'll take it.
Is that an iron nugget?
I carry it in my mouth. Very light.
You dropped it? Mine now.
I hide it under a stone.
This doesn't smell like stone.
I paw the dirt twice and uncover it.
Good for lining my nest.
You drop a lot of things.
I'll sniff it, then keep it.
Something is moving in the hole.

lines.zh: 石层下面有金属的回声。
lines.en: There's a metallic echo under the stone layer.
There's the smell of ore over there.
I fix my eyes that way.
Did you hear my chirp?
I claw this layer of dirt open.
Something's underneath.

lines.zh: 矿脉的味道从那边飘来。
lines.en: The smell of ore drifts from over there.
I know that sound.
I'm going over by the stones.
I follow that smell.
I claw through layer after layer of soil.
It can't escape. I can smell it.
I pause to listen.
My claws hit something hard.
Two more scoops and I'm there.
Don't block the hole.

lines.zh: 我扒开土，爪尖碰到硬物。
lines.en: I claw the soil away; my claw tip hits something hard.
Something's rattling down there.
I don't take my eyes off it.
One swipe and dirt flies.
I bite its tail.
This little thing is quick.
I pin it down.
Claws first, teeth after.
The smell of ore finds my nose.
This bite will settle it.
I knocked it over.
I back off and watch it.
Fighting isn't my strong suit.

lines.zh: 恶地的碎石堆里，我露出耳朵。
lines.en: In the badlands rubble, I poke out my ears.
I know this badland well.
My tail comes out first.
I shake the sand off my coat.
There's an unfamiliar smell in the wind.
I crouch beside a clump of dry grass.

lines.zh: 这里是晒太阳的好地方。
lines.en: This is a good spot for sunning.
I circle once to look around.
It's cool under the stones.
I walk out from behind a mound.
Fire singed my fur. Terrifying.

lines.zh: 跳得高一点落下来，没事。
lines.en: Off a high rock, and I land fine.

lines.zh: 水淹到鼻子，我拼命扑腾。
lines.en: Water up my nose. I thrash hard.

lines.zh: 轰的一声，我吓得钻进土里。
lines.en: A boom, and I dive into the dirt.
My tail is banded ring by ring.
The spell clings and my fur stands up.

lines.zh: 饿了，连挖土的力气都没。
lines.en: So hungry I can't even dig.
The thunder was too close. I can't stop shaking.

lines.zh: 脚下空空的，我抓不到东西。
lines.en: Nothing under my feet to grip.
